# dsp::reverb2

Module file: `modules/dsp/reverb2.mla`

[`dsp::reverb2`](DSP-Reverb2) is an independently implemented, allocation-free stereo
algorithmic reverb. Its late field is an eight-delay Householder
feedback-delay network (FDN), preceded by input allpass diffusion and predelay.
Separate early-reflection taps, fractional-delay modulation, input bandwidth,
high-frequency damping, bass decay, stereo width, and output controls make it
more configurable than [`dsp::reverb`](DSP-Reverb).

No MVerb source, topology, tuning constants, or class structure is copied into
this module. MVerb is GPL-3.0 software; `reverb2` instead uses original code and
delay tuning built from general published FDN and allpass techniques.

## API

- `Reverb2::new(sample_rate_hz)`
- `reset()` and `process_stereo(left, right)`
- `set_type(type)` and `get_type()`
- `set_size(value)` — room scale from `0..1`; clears delay history
- `set_decay_seconds(seconds)` — approximately `0.08..120` seconds
- `set_damping(value)` — `0` is bright and `1` is dark
- `set_bass_multiplier(value)` — low-frequency feedback multiplier `0.5..1.2`
- `set_diffusion(value)` and `set_input_bandwidth(value)`
- `set_predelay_ms(milliseconds)` — `0..500 ms`
- `set_early_mix(value)` and `set_stereo_width(value)`
- `set_modulation(depth_ms, rate_hz)` — `0..5 ms`, `0.01..5 Hz`
- `set_mix(value)` and `set_gain(value)`
- `set_gate_enabled(enabled)`
- `set_gate(attack_ms, hold_ms, release_ms, threshold, depth)`
- `set_freeze(enabled)` — lossless tank feedback with bounded writes

The gate controls only the wet output envelope; the late tank continues behind
the closed gate. This gives clap tails a clean, editable cutoff without
destroying the internal reflections. Attack, hold, release, detector threshold,
and closed-gate depth are independently adjustable.

## Presets

`Reverb2Type` retains the existing library preset names: `Hall`, `Room`,
`Plate`, `Gated`, `Reverse`, `NonlinearShort`, and `NonlinearLong`. It adds:

- `Custom` — keeps the current controls, disables preset shaping, and resets
  history so every setter can define the sound.
- `InfiniteHall` — unity-gain, undamped tank feedback for an ASR-10-inspired
  persistent hall. It is an original effect, not an Ensoniq algorithm
  emulation. Call `set_freeze(false)` or `reset()` to release/clear it.

```rust
mod dsp::reverb2;

use dsp::reverb2::Reverb2;
use dsp::reverb2::Reverb2Frame;
use dsp::reverb2::Reverb2Type;

var reverb: Reverb2 = Reverb2::new(48000.0f);
reverb.set_type(Reverb2Type::Gated);
reverb.set_gate(1.0f, 145.0f, 45.0f, 0.01f, 0.0f);
reverb.set_mix(0.75f);

let frame: Reverb2Frame = reverb.process_stereo(input_left, input_right);
let output_left: f32 = frame.left();
let output_right: f32 = frame.right();
```

Delay storage is allocated by `new()` for sample rates from 8 kHz through
384 kHz. `process_stereo()` performs no allocation, file I/O, or locking. Use
one mutable instance for each independent stereo stream.
